chunks.content: PM-JAY (Ayushman Bharat) provides free health coverage up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year. Eligibility is based on SECC 2011 data for rural and urban categories. Rural families in categories 1-6 (D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D7) are eligible. Check eligibility using your ration card number or Aadhaar at the nearest Ayushman Mitra desk or PM-JAY portal.

PM-JAY covers 1,929 procedures including NCD treatment, cardiac care, dialysis, and hospitalization. Treatment is cashless at empanelled hospitals. Show your Ayushman card or Aadhaar at any PM-JAY empanelled hospital. No payment needed for covered procedures.

To enroll in PM-JAY: Visit nearest Ayushman Mitra at CHC/PHC with Aadhaar and ration card. If your family is in SECC database, you get a Golden Card on the spot. If not listed, contact the District Collector office for inclusion. Toll-free helpline: 14555.

PM-JAY covers NCD-related hospitalization including cardiac procedures, stroke treatment, and complications of diabetes and hypertension. Outpatient medicines at government facilities are free under NHM. For PM-JAY inpatient coverage, visit an empanelled hospital.
